bio: Amy Gledhill won the Edinburgh Comedy Award in 2024 and is one half of cult double act The Delightful Sausage. A northern stand-up with a gift for absurdist commitment.
Armando Iannucci is the Scottish satirist behind The Thick of It and Veep, the director of The Death of Stalin and a co-creator of Alan Partridge.
Joanna Page is the Welsh actor who played Stacey in Gavin & Stacey, and Judy, the stand-in, in Love Actually.
Joel Dommett is a stand-up and presenter who hosts The Masked Singer UK, and first found wide fame on I’m a Celebrity… Get Me Out of Here!
Kumail Nanjiani is a Pakistani-American comedian and actor (Silicon Valley, Eternals) who co-wrote The Big Sick with his wife, Emily V. Gordon, earning an Oscar nomination.

title: Cube is good.
analysis: Joanna opened with 22pts, taking the live orange task outright (5–0–0–0–0). Armando and Joel tied on 11pts. Kumail's 9pts was the series low. Range of 13pts — tied with ep5 for the widest spread of the series.

title: Leg up, Johnny!
analysis: Amy won with 20pts. Armando was disqualified on the bowling task. Kumail's bold choice of the full outfit paid off with 5pts. One of the tightest episodes of the series — just 7pts between 1st and 5th.

bio: Chloe Petts is a critically acclaimed stand-up and an Edinburgh Fringe favourite.
Isy Suttie is an award-winning comedian, writer, songwriter and actor, best known as Dobby in Peep Show.
Matt Lucas is a BAFTA-winning actor, comedian, author and presenter: co-creator of Little Britain, George Dawes on Shooting Stars, Nardole in Doctor Who and a former Great British Bake Off host.
Nina Conti is an actor, comedian and ventriloquist, known for her foul-mouthed puppet Monk and for turning audience members into human puppets with half-masks.
Richard Ayoade is a multi-award-winning comedian, actor, writer and director: Moss in The IT Crowd, director of Submarine and The Double, and host of Travel Man.

title: In My Mind There's a River
analysis: Chloe Petts wins the series opener with 19pts. Matt Lucas's 1:37 golden-apple run was untouchable — Isy Suttie and Richard Ayoade were both disqualified on it. Chloe and Nina Conti tied for the best self-duet (5pts each), and Richard's belt-item recall (5pts) was the only bright spot in an otherwise rough week for him (13pts, joint-last with Isy).

title: The Butterfly Centurion
analysis: Chloe Petts wins The Butterfly Centurion with 21pts, bouncing straight back from the previous week's low. Nina Conti had the strongest underlying week — winning three of the five tasks (gleek, before & after photos, form & noughts) — but a disqualification on the live coloured-rolls task (0pts, one of three contestants DQ'd for moving multiple rolls at once) left her 2nd on 17pts. Isy Suttie had the toughest week, 9pts, propping up the table.

title: An Act of Self-Erasure
analysis: Isy Suttie wins An Act of Self-Erasure with a dominant 24pts — top or joint-top on four of the five tasks, including the earpiece-identity task and the live Bayeux Tapestry drawing. Nina Conti was a distant 2nd on 21pts. Richard Ayoade had his toughest week yet: 9pts, including a zero on the earpiece task after failing to convince anyone either way.
